_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/costs/test_process_cost.py. t_process_attendant is Void Attendant (the processor cost on an activated ability), t_process_nullifier is Ulamog's Nullifier (the cost as a may's pay, 'if you do, counter target spell'), t_process_ritual the cost as an additional cost to cast, the printed shape of the original Ulamog's Nullifier. Never part of a deck list.
